"365" is a song by German music producer Zedd and American singer Katy Perry.
It was released on 14 February 2019 along with its music video, directed by Warren Fu.

The song reached number one in Bulgaria and Israel as well as the top 10 in Lebanon, Lithuania, Mexico, and Serbia, the top 20 in Argentina, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, and the top 30 in the Czech Republic, the Netherlands, Singapore, and Slovenia.
German DJ Zedd has released three studio albums, one compilation album, 13 music videos, three extended plays, 38 singles (including two as a featured artist) and 30 remixes.
